title: Flutter Android blocks HTTP API while iOS debug build succeeds
symptoms: SocketException / Failed host lookup after switching to device
Same URL works on iOS simulator
cause: Android disallows cleartext by default; iOS simulator ATS behavior and local networking can differ, masking the issue.
solution: Use HTTPS for shared environments. For local-only development, scope network security config tightly and never ship broad cleartext allowances.
workaround: adb reverse + local HTTPS proxy for device testing.
